cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_pappsomspp CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# The Qt component packages (qtbase/qt5compat/qtbase-sql-dbus/qtdeclarative/
# qtsvg) and libodsstream ship their CMake configs under <pkg>/lib/cmake but
# are not generated by CMakeDeps; the conanfile passes their folders through
# this environment variable (semicolon-separated).
if(DEFINED ENV{PAPPSOMSPP_PREFIX_PATHS})
    list(PREPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "$ENV{PAPPSOMSPP_PREFIX_PATHS}")
    message(STATUS "PAPPSOMSPP prefix paths: $ENV{PAPPSOMSPP_PREFIX_PATHS}")
endif()

# The package installs only PappsoMSppStaticTargets.cmake under
# lib/cmake/pappsomspp/ (no PappsoMSppConfig.cmake — upstream does not
# install(EXPORT) a config). Load the static targets directly.
set(QT_ADDITIONAL_PACKAGES_PREFIX_PATH "$ENV{PAPPSOMSPP_QT_EXTRA_PREFIX}")
find_package(Qt6 COMPONENTS Core Gui Xml Concurrent Sql Svg REQUIRED)
# Chain package configs (liblzf/OdsStream/PwizLite/boost/zlib/zstd/
# sqlite3) are generated by CMakeDeps in the generators folder — load
# them so the StaticTargets' INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES resolve.
find_package(Qt6 COMPONENTS Qml REQUIRED)
find_package(PwizLite REQUIRED)
find_package(QuaZip-Qt6 REQUIRED)
find_package(OdsStream REQUIRED)
find_package(liblzf REQUIRED)
find_package(Boost REQUIRED)
find_package(zlib REQUIRED)
find_package(zstd REQUIRED)
find_package(sqlite3 REQUIRED)
# Map the conan-generated target names to the ones the
# PappsoMSppStaticTargets INTERFACE expects.
if(NOT TARGET SQLite3::SQLite3 AND TARGET sqlite3::sqlite3)
    add_library(SQLite3::SQLite3 ALIAS sqlite3::sqlite3)
endif()
if(NOT TARGET Zstd::Zstd AND TARGET zstd::libzstd)
    add_library(Zstd::Zstd ALIAS zstd::libzstd)
endif()
if(NOT TARGET ZLIB::ZLIB AND TARGET zlib::zlib)
    add_library(ZLIB::ZLIB ALIAS zlib::zlib)
endif()
set(_pmspp_targets_dir "$ENV{PAPPSOMSPP_TARGETS_DIR}")
include("${_pmspp_targets_dir}/PappsoMSppStaticTargets.cmake")

add_executable(test_pappsomspp test_pappsomspp.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test_pappsomspp PRIVATE PappsoMSpp::Core_static)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME pappsomspp_core_api COMMAND test_pappsomspp)
